description: This file defines a static class 'AdoNetInvariants' that holds well-known, vendor-specific invariant names for various database connectors used within different Orleans storage namespaces. It includes a list of supported invariants and constants for each supported database type.

classes.name: AdoNetInvariants
classes.description: A static class containing constants and a collection of invariant names for various database providers used in Orleans storage implementations.

methods.name: Invariants
methods.description: A collection of supported invariant names for different database providers.
